prompts.prompt: Kitchen round: pass the device to the actor, then let the guesser look away before reveal.
Morning round: hand over the screen privately before the action appears.
Travel round: the actor reveals this card while the guesser faces the other direction.
Pet round: swap who holds the device and hide the revealed action from the guesser.
Weather round: pass, reveal, and return the device face down before acting.
Date-night round: only the actor may see the action after tapping reveal.
Music round: give the actor the screen while the guesser closes their eyes.
Cleaning round: privately reveal the next silent scene to the actor.
Cooking round: turn the screen away from the guesser before revealing.
Photo round: the actor checks the card alone, then starts without speaking.
Fitness round: pass the device across and reveal only when the guesser cannot peek.
Movie round: hide the screen, reveal the scene, and begin the silent performance.
Shopping round: let the new actor privately open the action card.
Beach round: the guesser turns around while the actor reveals the movement.
Technology round: transfer the device before showing the secret action.
Celebration round: reveal privately, lock the screen, and act the scene.
Restaurant round: the actor reads the reveal while their partner looks away.
Garden round: pass the screen to the actor for the next hidden scene.
Dance round: keep the answer private after the actor taps reveal.
Home-repair round: the guesser covers their eyes during the reveal.
Winter round: hand the actor the device and turn away before the action appears.
Coffee round: only the performer sees the reveal before starting.
Laundry round: pass the card privately and hide it once the action is known.
Camping round: the actor reveals the prompt behind the guesser's back.
Game-night round: switch roles, pass the device, and reveal in secret.
Rainy-day round: shield the screen while the performer reads the action.
Phone-call round: the actor alone checks the reveal, then puts the device down.
Bakery round: give the screen to the performer before exposing the hidden action.
Museum round: the guesser looks away as the actor unlocks the scene.
Finale round: pass and reveal the last action without giving the guesser a glimpse.
